memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Reason for visit: acute left-sided sciatica.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: She reports 10‑day history of sharp left buttock pain radiating to the posterior thigh, worse on sitting and forward bending. No bowel/bladder disturbance.
EXAMINATION: BP 118/76 mmHg, weight 58 kg, height 1.60 m, BMI 22.6 (normal). Straight leg raise positive at 40° left, negative right. Lumbar spine tenderness paraspinally L4‑L5.
IMPRESSION: Acute lumbar radiculopathy (sciatica) likely discogenic.
ARRANGEMENTS: Started pregabalin 75 mg BD, diclofenac 50 mg BD after food, methylcobalamin 1500 mcg OD. Advised heat application, gentle stretching, avoid heavy lifting. Return if: chest pain, breathlessness, fever >39°C, new numbness/weakness, bowel/bladder incontinence, or worsening pain despite meds.

memories.author: D03
memories.text: Straight leg raise test: Left leg positive at 40°, right leg negative. Suggests left L5‑S1 radiculopathy.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Reason for visit: follow‑up on sciatica.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Pain decreased to 3/10, occasional tingling in left foot. Able to sit longer.
EXAMINATION: BP 120/78 mmHg, weight 58 kg, BMI 22.6 (normal). Straight leg raise now 50° left. No spinal tenderness.
IMPRESSION: Improving radiculopathy, likely resolving.
ARRANGEMENTS: Continue current meds. Advised graded walking, core strengthening. Return if: chest pain, breathlessness, fever >39°C, new weakness, bowel/bladder change, or pain >5/10.

memories.author: D03
memories.text: MRI lumbar spine: L4‑L5 disc bulge causing left lateral recess narrowing, compressing exiting L5 nerve root. No cord compression.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Reason for visit: discuss MRI findings.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Pain 4/10, intermittent tingling.
EXAMINATION: BP 119/77 mmHg, weight 58 kg, BMI 22.6 (normal). Straight leg raise 48° left.
IMPRESSION: MRI shows L4‑L5 disc bulge with L5 radiculopathy, correlating with symptoms.
ARRANGEMENTS: Continue pregabalin, diclofenac, methylcobalamin. Add vitamin D3 1000 IU OD. Physiotherapy referral sent. Return if: chest pain, breathlessness, fever >39°C, worsening weakness, bowel/bladder symptoms.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Reason for visit: physiotherapy progress review.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Pain 2/10, occasional mild ache after therapy.
EXAMINATION: BP 118/75 mmHg, weight 58 kg, BMI 22.6 (normal). Straight leg raise 55° left.
IMPRESSION: Continued improvement, mild residual discomfort.
ARRANGEMENTS: Continue meds. Advice to maintain core exercises, avoid prolonged sitting. Return if: chest pain, breathlessness, fever >39°C, new numbness/weakness, bowel/bladder change, or pain >4/10.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Fasting lipid profile: Total cholesterol 168 mg/dL (<200), LDL 95 mg/dL (<130), HDL 52 mg/dL (>40), triglycerides 88 mg/dL (<150). Fasting blood sugar 84 mg/dL (70‑99). All within normal limits.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Reason for visit: gastric discomfort after diclofenac.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Epigastric burning after meals, no vomiting. Sciatica pain 1/10.
EXAMINATION: BP 122/80 mmHg, weight 58 kg, BMI 22.6 (normal). Abdomen soft, mild epigastric tenderness.
IMPRESSION: Likely NSAID‑induced gastritis; sciatica well controlled.
ARRANGEMENTS: Stop diclofenac. Continue pregabalin 75 mg BD, methylcobalamin 1500 mcg OD, vitamin D3 1000 IU OD. Prescribe pantoprazole 40 mg OD for 2 weeks. Return if: chest pain, breathlessness, fever >39°C, vomiting, melena, or worsening back pain.
